basic_info.description: Stylish and modern 2BD/1BA condo offering 757 sq ft of well-designed living space in the heart of San Francisco's iconic Lower Nob Hill. This courtyard-facing unit features floor-to-ceiling windows, hardwood floors, abundant natural light, in-unit washer/dryer, and a private balcony off one of the bedrooms. Built in 2010, the home is located in a well-maintained elevator building with a shared common courtyard and private storage in the garage. With a Walk Score of 99, you're just steps from Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, Union Square, tech shuttles, public transit, Huntington Park, and the vibrant Polk Street dining scene. Enjoy life in one of the city's sunnier microclimates with unbeatable walkability and access to everything SF has to offer. HOA dues $622/mo. No parking.
